subject: Trial evaluation & integration commitments — Zephyr Retail
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@zephyretail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@zephyretail.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial eval & integration: success criteria and next steps

Marcus / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — Priya and I appreciated the concrete examples around streaming and token-cost tradeoffs. Per our conversation, we want to move to a short trial to validate three things for Zephyr Retail: 

- Success criteria (must-haves):
  - API latency: p50 < 150ms for recommendations endpoint at 200 RPS (baseline traffic will ramp during a holiday test).
  - Functional: accurate contextual recommendations with session-aware prompts + tool-calling to our product catalog (catalog API: https://api.zephyr.com/v1/catalog).
  - Security/compliance: VPC peering and audit logs for inference requests for SOC-aligned review.

- Evaluation plan & timeline: 3-week trial: week 1 integration + synthetic runs, week 2 throughput + latency validation, week 3 acceptance and handoff.

- Ownership: We will allocate Priya (Platform lead) for integration and Ravi (backend) for SDK work. We need a short SDK example for streaming session state and the API routes to call. Also want to confirm endpoint names, streaming behavior, and tool-calling examples (product lookup -> price/availability).

Attached our acceptance criteria spreadsheet (zephyr_acceptance_criteria.xlsx). Please confirm Redwood-side owners, a proposed integration checklist, and any required account/contract steps.

Best,
Samir Patel
Senior Engineering Manager | Zephyr Retail
+1 415-555-0192

--
Attachment: zephyr_acceptance_criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet, 38KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@zephyretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial eval & integration: success criteria and next steps

Samir / Priya — thanks for the clear acceptance goals. Quick recap and proposed technical plan from Redwood: 

Recap (agreeing on must-haves):
- p50 < 150ms for the /v1/recommendations route at 200 RPS (we'll measure both cold and warm KV cache scenarios).
- Support streaming session context with per-session KV cache and an example of tool-calling to your catalog API.
- Private network options: we'll provision a VPC endpoint and capture request audit logs for the trial window.

Proposed POC phases & timeline (3 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + environment access (VPC peering request, API keys).
2) Week 1: SDK integration + sample app (we'll deliver a Node/Go sample that demonstrates streaming and tool-calling).
3) Week 2: Load tests & latency verification (synthetic + replay of 1M events).
4) Week 3: Acceptance checks and handoff (compare against your spreadsheet gates).

Immediate next steps / owners: 
- Marcus (me) — deliver SDK sample, integration sketch, and streaming route docs by EOD Monday (attachment: marcus_integration_sketch.png).
- Ben Carter — will be primary CS contact for runbook and test orchestration; he'll share load-test harness and collection scripts.
- Marissa Cole — will coordinate trial activation and pricing baseline; will follow up on procurement/contract items.
- Priya / Ravi (Zephyr) — provide VPC peering CIDR, test dataset S3 location, and a contact for the catalog API auth flow.

Integration specifics (short):
- SDKs: Node + Go + Python samples. The sample will show: open streaming session (POST /v1/sessions), append user events, call /v1/recommendations with session id, and demonstrate tool-calling webhook to your catalog.
- API routes: /v1/sessions (streaming), /v1/recommendations (sync + streaming), /v1/tools/catalog-lookup (webhook pattern).
- Tool-calling: we will send a normalized JSON payload to your webhook with product_id and context; expect a status/price response. Retries and error semantics will be documented.
- Observability: per-token latency, KV hit-rate, and per-request trace ids exported to your tracing backend (we can push spans to X-Ray or Datadog).

Attachments: integration sketch + Redwood POC template (redwood_poc_template.pdf).

If that matches, I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with your team Monday 10am PT. Thoughts?

—Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

--
